svg.title: Sound engineer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as sound engineer, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: Three fader channels on a mixing console sit at deliberately different levels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
